exposure: colloid preload (6% hydroxyethyl starch 130/0.4 5 mL/kg before spinal anesthesia)
crystalloid co-load (Ringer's lactate solution 10 mL/kg with subarachnoid injection)
norepinephrine infusion (4 mug/min starting with subarachnoid injection)
cohort: 100 pregnant women undergoing elective cesarean section under combined spinal-epidural anesthesia
finding: There was no significant difference in the incidence of hypotension during cesarean section between women receiving colloid preload and those receiving crystalloid co-load, when both groups also received prophylactic norepinephrine infusion.
